name: Stanley-Whitman House

dates.altered: The lean-to was added by the second owner, Solomon Whitman (Wikipedia); the NPS says the house 'incorporates earlier features typical of late-17th-century work, including its frame'.
dates.note: The Wikipedia infobox and the node's exemplar agree on c. 1720; the museum's own site counts its birthday from 31 December 1720.
